With 16+ years of experience and over 800+ engineering and product employees supported, we design production-grade machine learning pipelines, LLM systems, RAG architectures, and MLOps governance frameworks. narrative.subtitle: Exploring collective coordination, governance, and institutional alignment through narrative and thought experiments.
narrative.disclosure_desc: The MeWe series is developed through an iterative collaboration between myself and modern language models. The ideas, worldbuilding, themes, questions and direction originate from my ongoing research interests. AI is used as a collaborative writing partner to explore alternatives, refine prose, experiment with narrative structure and accelerate iteration. Final editorial decisions, conceptual direction and thematic coherence remain human-guided.
narrative.research_philosophy: Why Speculative Fiction? Some questions are difficult to investigate through technical writing alone. Stories allow us to simulate societies, organizations, incentives, and long-term consequences — serving as speculative research instruments alongside software and consulting.

faq.q: What does Mentat Commons do?
faq.a: Mentat Commons is an AI Strategy and Decision Systems consultancy. We design production-grade machine learning pipelines, LLM systems, custom RAG systems, and MLOps governance frameworks. We also run corporate workshops and provide fractional AI leadership.

faq.q: Who owns and runs Mentat Commons?
faq.a: Mentat Commons is founded and led by Nandhini Anand Jeyahar, a systems architect and facilitator with over 16 years of experience across machine vision, cognitive science, and data engineering.

faq.q: Where is Mentat Commons located and do you work remotely?
faq.a: We operate remotely and serve clients worldwide. All project scoping, software engineering, systems auditing, and workshops are conducted via remote collaboration tools.

faq.q: What industries do you work with?
faq.a: We work with startups, SMEs, NGOs, research labs, universities, product companies, and engineering teams across tech, waste management, municipal policy, solar optimization, and restorative justice circles.

faq.q: How much does AI strategy consulting cost?
faq.a: Our AI Strategy scoping and feasibility consulting starts at $12,000 for a fixed-scope engagement, typically ranging between $12,000 and $25,000 depending on organization size and data complexity.

faq.q: What is the typical duration of an engagement?
faq.a: Engagements typically run for 2 to 12 weeks. Scoping sprints run for 2 to 4 weeks, custom machine learning projects run for 4 to 8 weeks, and fractional leadership retainers run for 3 to 12 months.

faq.q: Do you build production-grade AI systems or just mockups?
faq.a: We build fully containerized, tested, production-grade systems. This includes PyTorch classification pipelines, Qdrant vector databases, FastAPI microservices, and Docker containers ready for deployment.

faq.q: What is your technology stack for Machine Learning?
faq.a: Our core ML/AI engineering stack includes Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, CUDA, Docker, FastAPI, Qdrant, pgvector, MLflow, and evidently AI.

faq.q: Do you deploy on AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform?
faq.a: Yes. We design cloud-agnostic containerized architectures using Docker and Kubernetes, allowing deployment across AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, or custom private servers.

faq.q: What is Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and when should we use it?
faq.a: RAG is an architecture that fetches relevant documents from a database and passes them to an LLM to answer user queries with grounding. Use it when you need to answer questions using custom, private, or real-time document corpuses without expensive model fine-tuning.

faq.q: How do you prevent data leakage in LLM training and RAG setups?
faq.a: We enforce strict testing pipelines that isolate training datasets from evaluation datasets, utilize data contracts, and build custom validators (using Pydantic/Instructor) to audit and filter context strings before processing.

faq.q: What is silent model decay and how do you audit it?
faq.a: Silent model decay occurs when a model's accuracy drops in production due to changes in real-world user data patterns. We audit this by building drift detection pipelines (e.g. via Evidently AI) to track performance metrics and alert engineering teams.

faq.q: Can you train our internal engineering team in AI engineering?
faq.a: Yes. We offer AI and Data Engineering training starting at $8,000, delivering custom coding curricula, Jupyter notebooks, and hands-on coding labs to upskill your developers in vector databases and model integration.

faq.q: What are your corporate workshops like?
faq.a: Our workshops combine systems thinking and applied improvisation to help teams surface hidden product assumptions, align workflows, and establish clear decision-making rights. Pricing starts at $5,000.

faq.q: What does Fractional AI Leadership involve?
faq.a: It provides your business with a fractional CTO or VP of Engineering to guide technical architecture, scope projects, audit vendors, and build hiring rubrics. Retainers start at $8,000/month.

faq.q: How do you measure the success of an AI project?
faq.a: Success is measured using factual technical and business metrics, such as retrieval accuracy (MRR), query latency reduction, decision cycle acceleration, API token cost savings, and operational error rate reductions.

faq.q: What is your approach to AI safety, governance, and ethics?
faq.a: We prioritize empirical testing, data contract boundaries, explicit auditing logs, bias monitoring, and clear human-in-the-loop decision boundaries over speculative hype.

faq.q: Do you sign NDAs (Non-Disclosure Agreements)?
faq.a: Yes. We require a signed NDA before sharing or reviewing any proprietary datasets, code repositories, or strategic corporate roadmap details.

faq.q: How do we start an engagement with you?
faq.a: You can book a 30-minute technical discovery call via our contact form. We will review your current systems, data readiness, and business bottlenecks to define a structured scope of work.

faq.q: What is your pricing structure for discovery calls?
faq.a: All initial 30-minute technical discovery calls are free ($0). During this call, we determine if your problem aligns with our capabilities and whether your data is structured enough for engagement.

faq.q: What is the price of a 1-day scoping workshop?
faq.a: A intensive 1-day scoping workshop to define system architectures and align stakeholders is a flat fee of $2,500, which includes a pre-scoping call and a detailed technical report.

faq.q: What are the typical costs for a 2-week architecture sprint?
faq.a: A 2-week Architecture & Discovery Sprint costs approximately $12,000. It produces complete technical blueprints, dataset audits, and model feasibility recommendations.

faq.q: What are the typical costs for a 6-week implementation project?
faq.a: A typical 6-week production pipeline implementation (such as custom drift monitoring or vector search optimization) ranges between $35,000 and $50,000 depending on complexity.

faq.q: How do you handle intellectual property (IP) rights?
faq.a: Upon receipt of final payment, all custom software, pipeline configurations, training notebooks, and dashboards built specifically for your organization belong entirely to you.

faq.q: Do you support open-source LLMs like Llama and Mistral?
faq.a: Yes. We design architectures that support open-source models (such as Meta's Llama or Mistral) hosted locally or on private cloud instances, alongside proprietary APIs.

faq.q: What is your MLOps capability, and do you configure CI/CD for models?
faq.a: Yes. We configure automated model packaging, deployment pipelines, canary release scripts, and automated rollback triggers using GitHub Actions, Docker, and MLflow.

faq.q: How does Mentat Commons combine cognitive science with machine learning?
faq.a: We map cognitive limitations (like human attention constraints) and organizational incentives alongside machine learning outputs, ensuring that AI systems act as robust support systems rather than automated bottlenecks.

faq.q: What are your decision-action trees, and how do they reduce dashboard waste?
faq.a: Decision-action trees ensure every data query or model prediction maps directly to a discrete business action. If a metric cannot alter a decision path, we prune it from the system, reducing unnecessary infrastructure.

faq.q: Do you work with NGOs and academic research labs?
faq.a: Yes. We have structured data auditing capabilities tailored to NGOs, restorative justice groups, and academic research labs where model safety and alignment are critical.

faq.q: How do you verify the performance and accuracy of LLM outputs?
faq.a: We implement continuous testing loops using structured parsing rules, reference eval datasets, and metric logging tools like LangSmith to measure format accuracy, grounding, and response consistency.
